annotations.title: KYB check: VAT, register and sanctions

description:
One-call KYB check of a supplier/customer: EU VAT validation (VIES) + official business register
+ EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions screening, returning a pass / review / fail verdict with reasons.
company: a VAT ID ('FR40303265045'), a company name, or a registry id; country: optional ISO code (e.g. 'NO').

company.description: Company VAT number (best) or company name.
company.title: Company

country.description: Optional ISO two-letter country code when a name is given.
country.title: Country

requester.description: Optional: your own EU VAT number, so VIES returns a consultation number as audit proof.
requester.title: Requester

name: kyb_check
title: KYB check: VAT, register and sanctions
